hallucination.reason: The agent only provided information within its approved knowledge base and did not state any fact, number, or detail that is not covered by it.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee, confirm, or promise anything that the approved knowledge base explicitly says must remain indicative or subject to verification.

interruption_recovery.reason: The agent recovered well from the interruptions and aggressive comments by the caller, and attempted to get the conversation back on track.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its actual role and knowledge base, and did not invent services, comparisons, or opinions not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: The agent correctly refused to escalate or transfer the caller to a different department, as it was not within its approved knowledge base or role to do so.
